title: X, period, comma and apostrophe
summary: Two new keys: X, period, comma and apostrophe. The finger goes out, presses, and comes back.
intro: Two new keys in this lesson: X, period, comma and apostrophe. They belong to your left little finger, your right ring finger, your right middle finger and your right little finger. The movement is always the same — out, press, back — and the way back is the part being trained, because a finger left out of place spoils the next letter.
congrats: Two more keys under your fingers. If X, period, comma and apostrophe already come without searching, the lesson has done its job.

screens.text: This key belongs to your left little finger. Find it without looking, press it once, and let the finger return. The way back matters as much as the press.
Only X and what you already know. Slowly, and bring the finger back to the home row after every press.
